def Saisie():
    b = False
    while not (b):
        ch = str(input('< '))
        b = verif(ch)
    return ch


def verif(ch):
    ok = len(ch) <= 120
    i = -1
    while i < len(ch) - 1 and ok:
        i += 1
        ok = "A" <= ch[i] <= "Z"
    return ok


def Crypter(ch):
    R = ''
    R1 = ''
    for i in range(len(ch)):
        R += str(ord(ch[i]))
    for i in range(len(R)):
        R1 = R[i] + R1
    return R1


##########PP###############"
ch = Saisie()
R = Crypter(ch)
print(R)
